thread:
maya: Heads up — planning a telemetry migration for metering SLOs this Friday. Goal: route billing events through the new enrich pipeline and start emitting route_resolution_id at emit time, not post-agg. Will impact invoice previews and the console quota cards.

ajay: +1 on the migration but we need a compatibility layer. Some consumers still expect route_id in the original header.

katie: Can we do a phased rollout? shadowing first, then canary write, then cutover. Also worried about duplicate tokens during join window.

samir: Agreed. Proposal: 1) shadow for 48h, compare counts, 2) enable canary writes for 5% of tenants with route-override flag, 3) monitor invoice deltas and alert on >0.5% delta for 1h.

maya: sounds good. I sketched a minimal compatibility shim — if route_resolution_id missing, fall back to route_id header. But we must avoid double-counting when both present.

ajay: Important: the enrichment step will change the event schema slightly. Example snippet:

```
{ "event_id": "...", "client_id": "c123", "route_resolution_id": "r-abc123", "tokens": 42, "billing_plan": "pro" }
```

Old schema used `route_id` instead of `route_resolution_id`. Consumers that do naive equality joins will see drift.

katie: Console team: the per-route quota card aggregates by route_resolution_id today. If we start emitting later, the preview pipeline will show gaps for moves. Can we keep preview stable?

samir: For preview stability we can maintain a pre-agg join table keyed by session_id + fallback route_id. During shadow we validate join rates: we should log mismatches as `enrich-mismatch` metric.

ingest-bot: ingest-pipeline: shadow mode enabled on 1725235600 for group: meter-migration.

ajay: Telemetry-wise, we need three new metrics: `enrich.events.total`, `enrich.events.mismatch`, `enrich.events.duplicate_guard_hits`. Dashboards + alerts: create an alert when mismatch_ratio > 0.002 for 30m.

katie: UX: When canary writes reach 5% we should have a console toggle to show whether the preview is using legacy join or new join. That way SEs can toggle to reproduce deltas.

maya: Good idea. Add a link to the runbook in the toggle UI. We should also add an audit column on invoice-preview that shows which join produced the line item (legacy/new).

ajay: We also need to update the clientlib: if clients send legacy `route_id`, the edge proxy should translate it to `route_resolution_id` using the resolver cache. But cache misses might still happen and cause route-less events. Add a header `x-routesrc: legacy|resolver|computed`.

samir: Implementation note: to prevent double-counting we will set `dedupe_key = event_id || route_resolution_id` and have the ledger ignore duplicates within a 2m window. That should guard during simultaneous writes.

katie: Monitoring checklist for rollout:
- Compare hourly token tallies by tenant (legacy vs new)
- Invoice-preview delta histogram
- Number of `duplicate_guard_hits`
- Number of preview UI complaints (tagged `billing-preview` in #support)

maya: I'll own the canary config and the rollback criteria. If invoice-preview delta > 0.5% or `mismatch_ratio` > 0.5% sustained for 1h we rollback.

ajay: One more thing: rounding/quantization differences were biting us last time — make sure aggregation uses the same ordering and cutoff codepaths. We're reusing tally-service, so confirm the join uses `INVENTORY_DECISION = prefer_route_resolution_id` flag.

samir: Will add integration test that replays a mixed stream of legacy+new events into the tally service and asserts no net-token delta beyond 0.1%.

maya: Ops note: I'll schedule a 30m post-mortem channel for Friday + 1h on-call overlap with billing team.

deploy-bot: deploy status — shadow-enrich branch deployed to canary ingest nodes at 1725235800.

katie: Action items:
- maya: roll canary to 5% on Friday 09:00 PT
- ajay: add `x-routesrc` header + translation in edge proxy by Thursday EOD
- samir: add mismatch + duplicate metrics to the metering dashboard by Thursday EOD
- maya + katie: add invoice-preview audit column and UI toggle by Friday AM
- ajay: update clientlib docs and add migration note to API changelog

maya: I'll post the runbook and the canary link in #eng-platform when the shadow compares are green. :thumbsup:

ajay: Thanks — let's keep the migration low-noise. If anyone sees unexplained invoice blips tag me and @katie.

katie: tagging customers team to preempt support tickets: @customer-success please standby.

samir: I'll prepare the integration test PR and link in the thread.

maya: Thanks all.
